title_sq: Shitet apartament 2+1 ne rrugen e Elbasanit, prane Kompleksit Xibraku, Tirane ( ID 41211548)
description_sq:
Ne rrugen e Elbasanit, prane Kompleksit Xibraku, shitet apartament 2+1 ne pallat te ri me ashensor .
Apartamenti ka siperfaqe 133 m² (116 m² neto) me dokumenta te rregullta nga firma e ndertimit dhe ndodhet ne katin e trete. Apartamenti organizohet ne dhome ndenjeje, 2 dhoma gjumi, 2 tualete , ballkon dhe nje koridor .
I investuar tavane gipsi, ndricim me shina magnetike, spote inkaso, led, sistemi elektrik i ri, patinim, lyerje, sistem kondicionimi multisplit.
Cmimi: 235,000 euro
Godina perfundon per pak muaj.
Disponohen dhe 2 garazhe me siperfaqe 15 m², me kontrate porosie, ndodhen ne katin -1.
Cmimi: 25.000 euro (secili)
title_en: 2+1 apartment for sale in Elbasani Street, near Xibraku Complex, Tirana (ID 41211548)
description_en: On Elbasan street, near the Xibraku Complex, a 2+1 apartment is for sale in a new building with an elevator. The apartment has an area of ​​133 m² (net 116 m²) with regular documents from the construction company and is located on the third floor. The apartment is organized in a living room, 2 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, a balcony and a corridor. Invested gypsum ceilings, lighting with magnetic rails, recessed spotlights, led, new electrical system, patination, painting, multisplit air conditioning system. Price: 235,000 euros. The building will be completed in a few months. There are also 2 garages with an area of ​​15 m², with custom contracts, located on the -1st floor. Price: 25,000 euros (each)
